_doc: Model-side margins and curves of the v5.1 pilot view / body layer (tools/v51_pilot/view_score.py). Pre-registered 10-18 before any model-side score was computed; values from docs/SCORER_5_1_DESIGN.md §2.4 where it gives them. Do not tune on the pilot scores; a change gets a new file name and a note in data/v51_pilot/README.md.
_class_doc: reconcile_thresholds.json groups plus roof (SAM3 labels a roof seen from above as building, M50_033 K08) and a bin group; a GT class label matches every model element of the same group (the most favourable one counts, design §3)
_height_doc: |log(model / GT height_frac)|: full at log 1.4, zero at log 2.5
_posture_doc: model posture = 5.0.9 Timeline posture (stand / crouch / sit / lie by height), airborne when 5.0.9 Events.airborne; GT words not listed (climb, fall, rotate, lean) are not read by this layer
_speed_doc: body heights per second (5.0.9 Timeline speed / ref_h), mean over the run; walk 1.4 m/s = 0.8 h/s, run 2.5 m/s = 1.5 h/s for a 1.7 m person

segment_dir.note: 10-18 GT r1 screen_dir_segments only, as pvscore 5.0.10 seg_dir_away_deg / seg_dir_static_h; added before any segment was scored

chance.pairwise: permute (box, centre, depth) among the model's non-surface elements of each frame, recheck the same facts; R = mean over perms
chance.cell: uniform random cell, exact expectation per GT cell
chance.height: model height_frac log-uniform on [0.05, 1], expectation by 200-point quadrature
chance.posture_locomotion: best constant answer over the item's facts of the block

block_score: clip((P - R) / (1 - R), 0, 1) x coverage; P = mean over present facts, coverage = present facts / all facts (design §4)
